annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于全链条打击涉烟违法活动的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Combating Tobacco-Related Illegal Activities Across the Whole Chain
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office opinions (Guobanfa [2025] No. 44) on combating tobacco-related illegal activity across the whole chain: counterfeiting, smuggling, illegal distribution, online sales and e-cigarettes, with enforcement cooperation, technical equipment and professional enforcement support. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target overseas counterfeiting and smuggling at source, including maritime and border routes
Crack down on domestic counterfeit supply chains, storage, logistics and retail
Platforms must clear illegal online tobacco listings and report
Strengthen e-cigarette and new tobacco product oversight
Improve standards, enforcement equipment and professional enforcement teams
